description: This Java source file defines a class called FeaturePropertyCreatedStrategy that handles FeaturePropertyCreated events within a persistence strategy for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy class, applies event data to build or modify a ThingBuilder, and is part of the event handling mechanisms.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to process FeaturePropertyCreated events by updating a ThingBuilder with feature property details.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies the FeaturePropertyCreated event to a ThingBuilder.FromCopy instance, setting the feature property with data from the event.
